summary: Iteration 2 – full backend + frontend validation of the Pack Emploi variants refactor, new premium payment page, footer phone/socials, and admin PlanEditor variants editor. Backend: 7/7 pytest passed (added tests for pack_emploi variants shape + PUT /api/admin/plans/{id} persisting new variants and reflecting on public /api/plans, then reset). Frontend: pricing card 'dès 150€' (min variant) shown on inscription plan chip; /inscription?plan=pack_emploi shows Je recherche dropdown (data-testid=variant-picker + select-variant) with 'Stage / Alternance — 150€' and 'CDI — 499€'; switching to CDI updates submit button to 'Valider mon inscription · 499€'. After submit, new payment-page renders with #order number, order-recap detailing plan+variant+installments+total, big 'Payer 150€ maintenant' payment-link button, 3 trust cards (Paiement sécurisé, Accès sous 24h, Satisfaction suivie), SSL/données/sans-engagement footer badges — all in French. Admin plan-edit-pack_emploi shows Options/Variantes editor with Stage & CDI variants and add-variant-pack_emploi button. Liens de paiement view = 40 inputs (4 tage_mage + 4 pack_emploi_stage_alt + 4 pack_emploi_cdi + 28 custom). Footer phone (data-testid=footer-phone) renders '+237600000000'. No English error/failure strings observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Landing pricing uses 'dès {min}€' (French for 'starting at') instead of the exact literal 'à partir de {min}€' mentioned in the spec — semantically identical, no action needed unless spec strictly requires the phrase.

server.py: DEFAULT_PAYMENT_LINKS still lists legacy pack_emploi_1..4 keys but new variant-based flow uses pack_emploi_stage_alt_* / pack_emploi_cdi_*. The old legacy keys are still initialized (harmless) but /api/inscriptions still resolves link via f'{plan}_{installments}' → for pack_emploi it will fetch 'pack_emploi_1' etc., NOT the variant-specific link. The email confirmation therefore embeds the wrong (legacy) link for pack_emploi. Frontend payment-page uses the variant-specific key correctly, but the confirmation email path in server.py::create_inscription should also key by variant (e.g. `{plan}_{job_type}_{installments}` when job_type present). Recommend main agent align backend email link lookup with variant scheme.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests wrote TEST_ inscriptions (stage_alt 150, cdi 499), sample payment links (pack_emploi_stage_alt_1/2, pack_emploi_cdi_1, tage_mage_1), site socials, and briefly updated pack_emploi variants to 180/550 before resetting via /api/admin/plans/reset. Playwright also created a TEST inscription via UI (Stage/Alternance).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now contains 7 tests including variants shape check and admin plan PUT + reset roundtrip. Frontend flows verified end-to-end. Only outstanding note: create_inscription email link lookup ignores variant (uses legacy `{plan}_{installments}` key). Not a test-blocker but a functional gap; documented in critical_code_review_comments for main agent.
